label.description: Accessible name of the command palette, a searchable list of commands, files, versions and examples.

placeholder.message: Search commands, files, versions and examples
placeholder.description: Placeholder of the command palette's search field.

empty.description: Shown in the command palette when nothing matches the search.

kindCommand.description: Right-aligned hint on a command palette row that runs an app command.

kindEditor.description: Right-aligned hint on a command palette row that runs a code editor action, such as Go to line.

kindFile.description: Right-aligned hint on a command palette row that reveals one of the fiddle's files in the editor.

kindVersion.description: Right-aligned hint on a command palette row that switches the fiddle to an Electron version.

kindExample.description: Right-aligned hint on a command palette row that loads a built-in Show Me example.

runFailed.description: Toast title when a command palette item fails. {{label}} is the item's name, such as a command or file name.

electronVersion.description: Command palette row that switches to an Electron version. {{version}} is a version number such as 44.0.0.
